summary: Current main contains the newer QSA speculative CUDA-graph layout implementation from merged PR #37500 and the paged sparse-decode memory-safety fix from merged PR #38851, but the original GB10/SM121 TP2 semantic-corruption report cannot be revalidated on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU without the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 weights. Investigation did reproduce a current-head QSA+NEXTN draft-extend blocker: _speculative_max_row_length read draft_token_num, which EagleDraftExtendInput does not define. The narrow correction uses the canonical num_tokens_per_req field shared by verify and draft-extend, with a failing-before artifact and boundary regressions. This correction removes the blocker but is not claimed to resolve or reproduce the original silent corruption.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction using a real EagleDraftExtendInput(num_tokens_per_req=4); current base raised AttributeError because draft_token_num is absent. Raw output: reports/j-c87d3409775d/evidence/failing-before.txt
Five focused CPU regressions passed: real draft-extend input, canonical-width precedence, no-speculation boundary, ragged draft-extend graph padding, and target-verify capture-bucket padding.
Full focused QSA suite: 41 passed and 1 SM121-only test skipped on the assigned AMD GPU.

On AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), Triton block expansion matched the independent Torch reference, GPU graph metadata matched the legacy host path for decode/target-verify/draft-extend boundaries, and speculative padded-tail layouts matched an independent host oracle; 3 passed.
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, secret, and registered-test validation hooks all passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X, ROCm 7.2, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Raw output: reports/j-c87d3409775d/evidence/gfx950-graph-numerics.txt

remaining_limitations: No GB10/SM121 NVIDIA GPU was available; the SM121-only sparse attention kernel test was skipped.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so TP2 over RoCEv2 and multi-node behavior were not tested.

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 weights were not available, so the HTTP semantic gates, 1024-token non-looping generation, approximately 25K marker retrieval, and eager-versus-decode-graph output comparison were not run.
The tiny Llama transport fixture cannot qualify Qwen4-Exp/QSA/NEXTN architecture semantics and therefore was not substituted for the reported model.
The correction addresses the independently reproduced draft-extend metadata crash only; it does not establish that the original silent semantic corruption is fixed.
